script:
export PATH=$PATH:/opt/mssql-tools18/bin
systemd-run --unit=demo-blocking-tx --description='demo blocking transaction' sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P '${SA_PASSWORD}' -C -d DemoDB -Q "BEGIN TRAN; UPDATE Orders SET Amount=Amount+1 WHERE OrderId=1; WAITFOR DELAY '00:12:00'; ROLLBACK;"
sleep 2
sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P '${SA_PASSWORD}' -C -d DemoDB -W -Q "SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT session_id, status, open_transaction_count FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process=1;"
echo SCENARIO_3_TRIGGERED
